descriptions.text: Mirror mirror on the wall… $90 million stolen, but that’s not all. Two exploits hit Mirror Protocol, and the larger of the two wasn’t even noticed at first.

On October 8, 2021, Mirror Protocol on Terra Classic was exploited due to a batch withdrawal vulnerability, allowing an attacker to repeatedly unlock and withdraw collateral via duplicate position IDs. Around $90 million in USTC was drained, and the exploit went undetected for months. The batch withdrawal function did not validate the uniqueness of user-supplied position IDs. As a result, the attacker could supply the same position ID multiple times in a single transaction, causing its balance to be summed repeatedly and unlocking more funds than their true collateral.
